claim: Large-scale populations in the world have been vaccinated with COVID-19 vaccines.
source: Large-scale populations in the world have been vaccinated with COVID-19 vaccines, however, breakthrough infections of SARS-CoV-2 are still growing rapidly due to the emergence of immune-evasive variants, especially Omicron.
evidence: This is stated as background information in the abstract without specific data or citations provided in this sentence.

claim: Breakthrough infections of SARS-CoV-2 are still growing rapidly due to the emergence of immune-evasive variants, especially Omicron.
source: Large-scale populations in the world have been vaccinated with COVID-19 vaccines, however, breakthrough infections of SARS-CoV-2 are still growing rapidly due to the emergence of immune-evasive variants, especially Omicron.
evidence: This is stated as a factual observation about the current pandemic situation.

claim: Mos-tri-RBD carries the key mutations from Omicron and other circulating variants.
source: Here, we present a mosaic-type trimeric form of spike receptor-binding domain (mos-tri-RBD) as a broad-spectrum vaccine candidate, which carries the key mutations from Omicron and other circulating variants.
evidence: This describes the design of the vaccine candidate presented in the study.

claim: Mos-tri-RBD, whether used alone or as a booster shot, elicited potent cross-neutralizing antibodies against Omicron and other immune-evasive variants in rats.
source: Tests in rats showed that the designed mos-tri-RBD, whether used alone or as a booster shot, elicited potent cross-neutralizing antibodies against not only Omicron but also other immune-evasive variants.
evidence: This is a primary finding from the experimental tests conducted in the study.

claim: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers induced by mos-tri-RBD were substantially higher than those elicited by homo-tri-RBD.
source: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers induced by mos-tri-RBD were substantially higher than those elicited by homo-tri-RBD (containing homologous RBDs from prototype strain) or the BIBP inactivated COVID-19 vaccine (BBIBP-CorV).
evidence: This is a comparative finding from the experimental data.

claim: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers induced by mos-tri-RBD were substantially higher than those elicited by BBIBP-CorV.
source: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers induced by mos-tri-RBD were substantially higher than those elicited by homo-tri-RBD (containing homologous RBDs from prototype strain) or the BIBP inactivated COVID-19 vaccine (BBIBP-CorV).
evidence: This is a comparative finding from the experimental data.

claim: Five SARS-CoV-2 strains, including Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Omicron, have been classified into variants of concern (VOCs) by the WHO.
source: Among the circulating variants, five strains, including Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Omicron, have been classified into variants of concern (VOCs) by the World Health Organization (WHO) (https://www.who.int/en/activities/tracking-SARS-CoV-2-variants/).
evidence: This is supported by a reference to WHO classification.

claim: Alpha became a globally dominant strain in early 2021.
source: Alpha, as the first VOC, became a globally dominant strain in early 2021, which was then replaced by Delta variant from the summer of 2021.
evidence: This is a statement about the epidemiological history of SARS-CoV-2 variants.

claim: Alpha was replaced by Delta variant from the summer of 2021.
source: Alpha, as the first VOC, became a globally dominant strain in early 2021, which was then replaced by Delta variant from the summer of 2021.
evidence: This is a statement about the epidemiological history of SARS-CoV-2 variants.

claim: Alpha and Delta variants exhibited one- to twofold and two- to threefold reductions in neutralizing titers, respectively, compared to serum from vaccinated individuals.
source: These two variants exhibited slightly and moderately less sensitivity to neutralization by serum from vaccinated individuals, with one- to twofold and two- to threefold reductions in neutralizing titers, respectively (Lipsitch et al., 2022; Muik et al., 2021; Widge et al., 2021; Planas et al., 2021; Wu et al., 2021b; Pegu et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by multiple citations to previous studies.

claim: Beta variant was 3- to 15-fold less susceptible to neutralization by vaccine-induced antibodies.
source: Beta variant showed significantly greater immune escape capability and was 3- to 15-fold less susceptible to neutralization by vaccine-induced antibodies (Lipsitch et al., 2022; Planas et al., 2021; Edara et al., 2021; Shen et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by multiple citations to previous studies.

claim: Gamma strain exhibited reduced neutralizing sensitivity, but the reduction was not as substantial as that of Beta strain.
source: Gamma strain also exhibited obvious reduced neutralizing sensitivity, but the reduction in neutralizing titers was not as substantial as that of Beta strain (Lazarevic et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2021; Dejnirattisai et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Lambda and Mu variants have been reported to have certain immune evasion abilities.
source: Besides that, the variants of interest (VOIs) designated by WHO, including Lambda and Mu, have also been reported to have certain immune evasion abilities (Liu et al., 2021; Lou et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Omicron variant was first detected in Botswana and reported from South Africa.
source: The Omicron variant, also known as B.1.1.529, was first detected in Botswana and reported from South Africa, which was considered to be associated with the sharp rise of infection cases in multiple provinces in South Africa (https://www.who.int/news/item/26-11-2021-classification-of-omicron-(b.1.1.529)-sars-cov-2-variant-of-concern).
evidence: This is supported by a reference to WHO information.

claim: Omicron was assigned as a VOC by the WHO two days after its discovery.
source: Preliminary evidence indicates that this variant may be more transmissible and may have a higher reinfection risk than other VOCs, and thus just two days after its discovery, Omicron has been assigned as a VOC by the WHO (Vaughan, 2021; Callaway, 2021; Kupferschmidt and Vogel, 2021; Torjesen, 2021).
evidence: This is supported by multiple citations.

claim: Omicron carries 15 mutations in the receptor binding domain (RBD) of the spike (S) protein.
source: Omicron carries 15 mutations in the receptor binding domain (RBD) of the spike (S) protein that is the immunodominant target of neutralizing antibodies.
evidence: This is a statement about the genetic characteristics of Omicron.

claim: The mean neutralizing titer at a 50% inhibitory dilution (ID50) of convalescent serum against pseudo-typed Omicron was significantly decreased 8.4-fold compared to the D614G strain.
source: Our recent study on the neutralizing sensitivity of the convalescent serum against pseudo-typed Omicron showed that the mean neutralizing titer at a 50% inhibitory dilution (ID50) was significantly decreased 8.4-fold compared to the D614G strain (Zhang et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to the authors' previous study.

claim: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers against Omicron variant in individuals administered by mRNA COVID-19 vaccines were dramatically reduced 8.6–22 folds compared to the D614G reference strain.
source: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers against Omicron variant in the individuals administered by mRNA COVID-19 vaccines were dramatically reduced 8.6–22 folds compared to the D614G reference strain and by contrast, only 4.3- to 5-fold decline was observed for Beta variant (Liu et al., 2022; Cele et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Only 4.3- to 5-fold decline in neutralizing antibody titers was observed for Beta variant in individuals administered by mRNA COVID-19 vaccines.
source: Neutralizing antibody ID50 titers against Omicron variant in the individuals administered by mRNA COVID-19 vaccines were dramatically reduced 8.6–22 folds compared to the D614G reference strain and by contrast, only 4.3- to 5-fold decline was observed for Beta variant (Liu et al., 2022; Cele et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Sera from individuals vaccinated with two doses of ChAdOx1 or Ad26.COV2.S failed to neutralize Omicron.
source: Sera from the individuals vaccinated with two doses of ChAdOx1 or Ad26.COV2.S failed to neutralize Omicron (Liu et al., 2022; Rössler et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Omicron variant evaded neutralization of the majority of existing SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibodies.
source: Tests on a panel of existing SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibodies showed that Omicron variant evaded neutralization of the majority of these antibodies (Cao et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to a previous study.

claim: As of February 2022, the Omicron variant has evolved into multiple lineages, including BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3.
source: As of February 2022, the Omicron variant has evolved into multiple lineages, including BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3.
evidence: This is a statement about the evolution of Omicron as of a specific date.

claim: Homo-tri-RBD consists of three RBDs from the prototype SARS-CoV-2 strain connected end-to-end into a single molecule and co-assembled into a trimeric form.
source: Guided by structural and computational analyses of S protein RBD, we have developed a trimeric form of RBD vaccine candidate, that is, the homologous trimeric RBD (homo-tri-RBD), in which three RBDs from the prototype SARS-CoV-2 strain were connected end-to-end into a single molecule and co-assembled into a trimeric form (Liang et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to the authors' previous work.

claim: Animal experiments and clinical trials have demonstrated potent protection offered by homo-tri-RBD against SARS-CoV-2.
source: Animal experiments and clinical trials have demonstrated potent protection offered by this vaccine against SARS-CoV-2 (Liang et al., 2022; Kaabi et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies.

claim: Homo-tri-RBD has completed phase I/II clinical trial and approved by the United Arab Emirates for emergency use.
source: At present, homo-tri-RBD has completed phase I/II clinical trial and approved by the United Arab Emirates for emergency use.
evidence: This is a statement about the regulatory status of the vaccine.

claim: Mos-tri-RBD contains key mutations derived from Omicron (BA.1) as well as other VOCs and VOIs.
source: Targeting SARS-CoV-2 Omicron and other immune-evasive variants, we present a mosaic-type trimeric RBD (mos-tri-RBD) vaccine candidate, in which the key mutations derived from Omicron (BA.1) as well as other VOCs and VOIs were integrated into the immunogen.
evidence: This describes the design of the vaccine candidate.

claim: RBD forms a relatively compacted and isolated domain in the structure of spike (S) protein.
source: RBD forms a relatively compacted and isolated domain in the structure of spike (S) protein, and the beta-sheets in the core as well as the existence of four disulfide bonds stabilizes the tertiary structure of the domain.
evidence: This is based on structural knowledge of the spike protein.

claim: The beta-sheets in the core and the existence of four disulfide bonds stabilize the tertiary structure of RBD.
source: RBD forms a relatively compacted and isolated domain in the structure of spike (S) protein, and the beta-sheets in the core as well as the existence of four disulfide bonds stabilizes the tertiary structure of the domain.
evidence: This is based on structural knowledge of the spike protein.

claim: The N- and C-termini of RBD are close together.
source: The N- and C-termini of RBD are close together, and there exist long loops in both termini.
evidence: This is based on structural knowledge of RBD.

claim: There exist long loops in both N- and C-termini of RBD.
source: The N- and C-termini of RBD are close together, and there exist long loops in both termini.
evidence: This is based on structural knowledge of RBD.

claim: Mos-tri-RBD consists of three RBDs, one derived from Omicron and two artificially designed to carry key mutations from SARS-CoV-2 variants.
source: Mos-tri-RBD also consisted of three RBDs, one of which was derived from Omicron and the other two were artificially designed to carry the key mutations appearing in SARS-CoV-2 variants.
evidence: This describes the design of mos-tri-RBD.

claim: One artificially designed RBD in mos-tri-RBD contains the mutations K417N, L452R, T478K, F490S and N501Y.
source: According to this criterion, a total of eight mutations were chosen and introduced into the two artificially designed RBDs (The details on these mutations were provided in Table 1), where one RBD contained the mutations of K417N, L452R, T478K, F490S and N501Y, and the other included K417T, S477N and E484K (Figure 1A).
evidence: This describes the specific mutations included in the vaccine design.

claim: One artificially designed RBD in mos-tri-RBD contains the mutations K417T, S477N and E484K.
source: According to this criterion, a total of eight mutations were chosen and introduced into the two artificially designed RBDs (The details on these mutations were provided in Table 1), where one RBD contained the mutations of K417N, L452R, T478K, F490S and N501Y, and the other included K417T, S477N and E484K (Figure 1A).
evidence: This describes the specific mutations included in the vaccine design.

claim: L452R is ranked 1st in observed frequency and is carried by Delta variant.
source: L452R	1	Delta
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: T478K is ranked 2nd in observed frequency and is carried by Delta and Omicron variants.
source: T478K	2	Delta, Omicron
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: N501Y is ranked 3rd in observed frequency and is carried by Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Omicron, and Mu variants.
source: N501Y	3	Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Omicron, Mu
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: E484K is ranked 4th in observed frequency and is carried by Beta, Gamma, and Mu variants.
source: E484K	4	Beta, Gamma, Mu
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: K417T is ranked 5th in observed frequency and is carried by Gamma variant.
source: K417T	5	Gamma
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: S477N is ranked 6th in observed frequency and is carried by Omicron variant.
source: S477N	6	Omicron
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: K417N is ranked 8th in observed frequency and is carried by Beta and Omicron variants.
source: K417N	8	Beta, Omicron
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: F490S is ranked 10th in observed frequency and is carried by Lambda variant.
source: F490S	10	Lambda
evidence: This is data from Table 1 showing mutation frequency and variant association.

claim: For each RBD in mos-tri-RBD, the residues 319–537 were truncated from the S protein to retain the long loops at both termini.
source: To facilitate the self-trimerization of mos-tri-RBD, for each RBD the residues 319–537 were truncated from the S protein to retain the long loops at both termini, as shown in Figure 1A.
evidence: This describes the design strategy for mos-tri-RBD.

claim: RBDs with the truncation scheme of residues 319–537 can correctly fold and co-assemble into a trimeric structure.
source: Our previous studies have shown that the RBDs with this truncation scheme can correctly fold and co-assemble into a trimeric structure (Liang et al., 2022).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to the authors' previous work.

claim: The recombinant mos-tri-RBD was expressed using CHO cells.
source: The recombinant mos-tri-RBD was expressed using CHO cells, and then purified by chromatography and ultrafiltration as described previously (Liang et al., 2022).
evidence: This describes the experimental method used.

claim: The theoretically calculated mass of each RBD in mos-tri-RBD is about 24–25 kDa.
source: Based on the sequence of the designed mos-tri-RBD, the theoretically calculated mass of each RBD was about 24–25 kDa, and that of the entire mos-tri-RBD was approximately 74 kDa.
evidence: This is a calculation based on the protein sequence.

claim: The theoretically calculated mass of the entire mos-tri-RBD is approximately 74 kDa.
source: Based on the sequence of the designed mos-tri-RBD, the theoretically calculated mass of each RBD was about 24–25 kDa, and that of the entire mos-tri-RBD was approximately 74 kDa.
evidence: This is a calculation based on the protein sequence.

claim: SDS-PAGE analysis displayed an obvious band corresponding to the molecular mass of about 92 kDa for mos-tri-RBD.
source: SDS-PAGE analysis displayed an obvious band corresponding to the molecular mass of about 92 kDa (Figure 1B), implying the formation of the trimeric RBD.
evidence: This is experimental data from SDS-PAGE shown in Figure 1B.

claim: The measured mass of mos-tri-RBD was larger than the theoretical value due to heavy glycosylation of the protein.
source: The measured mass was larger than the theoretical value calculated by the sequence, which was attributed to the heavy glycosylation of the protein as discussed in our previous studies (Liang et al., 2022).
evidence: This is an interpretation of the data supported by citation to previous work.

claim: MM117 is an RBD-specific monoclonal neutralizing antibody that can bind specifically with the RBDs of SARS-CoV-2 prototype, Omicron and Delta strains.
source: MM117 has been proved to be able to bind specifically with the RBDs of SARS-CoV-2 prototype, Omicron and Delta strains.
evidence: This is stated as a known property of the antibody.

claim: Protein concentration-dependent binding activity was observed for MM117 with mos-tri-RBD.
source: Protein concentration-dependent binding activity was observed for MM117, suggesting the formation of native conformation of the RBDs in mos-tri-RBD (Figure 1C).
evidence: This is experimental data from ELISA shown in Figure 1C.

claim: The hACE2 binding avidity of the RBD trimer is about 500-fold higher than that of the RBD monomer.
source: The studies of Routhu et al. demonstrated that the hACE2 binding avidity of the RBD trimer was about 500-fold higher than that of the RBD monomer (Routhu et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to a previous study.

claim: Rats were intramuscularly immunized using two doses of mos-tri-RBD mixed with Aluminum adjuvant three weeks apart.
source: To evaluate the cross-reactive immunogenicity of the designed mos-tri-RBD, we intramuscularly immunized rats using two doses of mos-tri-RBD mixed with Aluminum adjuvant three weeks apart.
evidence: This describes the experimental immunization protocol.

claim: Compared with the prototype virus, the Omicron variant exhibits substantially less susceptibility to neutralization elicited by two doses of BBIBP-CorV vaccination.
source: Live-virus neutralization assay showed that compared with the prototype virus, the Omicron variant exhibits substantially less susceptibility to neutralization elicited by two doses of BBIBP-CorV vaccination.
evidence: This is a finding from the live-virus neutralization assay.

claim: The GMT of neutralizing antibodies against prototype strain elicited by BBIBP-CorV was 699.
source: The geometric mean titer (GMT) of neutralizing antibodies against prototype strain was 699, whereas the Omicron-specific neutralizing ID50 in half of the rats was less than the detectable limit of the assay (Figure 2B), suggesting substantial evasion of Omicron variant from the immunity elicited by BBIBP-CorV.
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: The Omicron-specific neutralizing ID50 in half of the rats vaccinated with BBIBP-CorV was less than the detectable limit of the assay.
source: The geometric mean titer (GMT) of neutralizing antibodies against prototype strain was 699, whereas the Omicron-specific neutralizing ID50 in half of the rats was less than the detectable limit of the assay (Figure 2B), suggesting substantial evasion of Omicron variant from the immunity elicited by BBIBP-CorV.
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: Homo-tri-RBD vaccination significantly improved the neutralizing antibody GMT against Omicron virus from <31 to 1077, with a more than 34.7-fold increase compared to BBIBP-CorV.
source: Compared with BBIBP-CorV, homo-tri-RBD vaccination significantly improved the neutralizing antibody GMT against Omicron virus from <31 to 1077, with a more than 34.7-fold increase.
evidence: This is a comparative finding from the live-virus neutralization assay.

claim: Mos-tri-RBD vaccination elicited neutralizing GMT against Omicron of 2876, with 2.7-fold increase compared to homo-tri-RBD and >92.8-fold increase compared to BBIBP-CorV.
source: Furthermore, remarkably enhanced neutralizing ID50 titers against Omicron were elicited by mos-tri-RBD vaccination, in which the neutralizing GMT reached 2876, with 2.7-fold and >92.8-fold increases in comparison to the homo-tri-RBD and BBIBP-CorV vaccinations, respectively (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: The anti-Omicron neutralizing antibody response elicited by mos-tri-RBD was significantly higher than that of homo-tri-RBD (p=0.0057).
source: Statistical analysis showed that the anti-Omicron neutralizing antibody response elicited by mos-tri-RBD was significantly higher than that of homo-tri-RBD (p=0.0057) and the neutralization elicited by homo-tri-RBD was also significantly higher than that of BBIBP-CorV (p<0.0001).
evidence: This is a statistical analysis of the experimental data.

claim: The neutralization against Omicron elicited by homo-tri-RBD was significantly higher than that of BBIBP-CorV (p<0.0001).
source: Statistical analysis showed that the anti-Omicron neutralizing antibody response elicited by mos-tri-RBD was significantly higher than that of homo-tri-RBD (p=0.0057) and the neutralization elicited by homo-tri-RBD was also significantly higher than that of BBIBP-CorV (p<0.0001).
evidence: This is a statistical analysis of the experimental data.

claim: In rats immunized with BBIBP-CorV, the neutralizing antibody GMT against Beta variant was reduced by 2.1-fold in comparison with that against the prototype virus.
source: In the rats immunized with BBIBP-CorV, the neutralizing antibody GMT against Beta variant was reduced by 2.1-fold in comparison with that against the prototype virus, suggesting a considerable immune escape of the variant.
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay.

claim: The anti-Beta neutralizing antibody GMT elicited by homo-tri-RBD was increased from 328 to 2547 (7.8-fold) compared to BBIBP-CorV.
source: While, compared to BBIBP-CorV, the anti-Beta neutralizing antibody GMT elicited by homo-tri-RBD was increased from 328 to 2547 (7.8-fold), and further improved to 6917 (21.1-fold) by mos-tri-RBD vaccination (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: The anti-Beta neutralizing antibody GMT elicited by mos-tri-RBD was 6917, which is 21.1-fold higher than BBIBP-CorV.
source: While, compared to BBIBP-CorV, the anti-Beta neutralizing antibody GMT elicited by homo-tri-RBD was increased from 328 to 2547 (7.8-fold), and further improved to 6917 (21.1-fold) by mos-tri-RBD vaccination (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: For Delta variant, the neutralizing antibody GMTs induced by homo-tri-RBD and mos-tri-RBD were 5.1-fold and 8.6-fold, respectively, higher than that induced by BBIBP-CorV.
source: Similarly, for Delta variant, the neutralizing antibody GMTs induced by homo-tri-RBD and mos-tri-RBD were 5.1-fold and 8.6-fold, respectively, higher than that induced by BBIBP-CorV (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is experimental data from live-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 2B.

claim: The neutralizing antibody response against SARS-CoV-2 prototype strain stimulated by mos-tri-RBD was lower than that by homo-tri-RBD, but still comparable to that by BBIBP-CorV.
source: However, it should be noted that due to the absence of wild-type RBD in the mosaic antigen, the neutralizing antibody response against SARS-CoV-2 prototype strain stimulated by mos-tri-RBD was lower than that by homo-tri-RBD, but still comparable to that by BBIBP-CorV (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is an observation from the experimental data shown in Figure 2B.

claim: All three prime-boosting vaccinations induced elevated neutralizing antibodies against the pseudo-virus of SARS-CoV-2 prototype strain compared to the adjuvant control group.
source: Pseudo-virus neutralization assay demonstrated that all the three prime-boosting vaccinations induced elevated neutralizing antibodies in comparison to the adjuvant control group against the pseudo-virus of SARS-CoV-2 prototype strain.
evidence: This is a finding from the pseudo-virus neutralization assay.

claim: The neutralizing ID50 titers against prototype strain in the sera elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' were no less than those elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD'.
source: Although mos-tri-RBD did not contain the prototype RBD, the neutralizing ID50 titers against prototype strain in the sera elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' were no less than those elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD', both of which were significantly higher than those induced by 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccinations (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: The neutralizing ID50 titers against prototype strain elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' and 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD' were significantly higher than those induced by 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccinations.
source: Although mos-tri-RBD did not contain the prototype RBD, the neutralizing ID50 titers against prototype strain in the sera elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' were no less than those elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD', both of which were significantly higher than those induced by 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccinations (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: The neutralizing antibody GMTs against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3 elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccination were significantly reduced compared with the prototype pseudo-virus.
source: Compared with the prototype pseudo-virus, the neutralizing antibody GMTs against Omicron variant, including lineages BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3, elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccination were significantly reduced (Figure 3B), suggesting high immune escape capability of Omicron variant from the immunity offered by BBIBP-CorV.
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD' vaccination improved the neutralizing antibody GMTs against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3 pseudo-viruses from 383, <175 and <100 to 932, <372 and <340, respectively, compared to 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV'.
source: In comparison to homologous booster of BBIBP-CorV, the 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD' vaccination improved the neutralizing antibody GMTs against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3 pseudo-viruses from 383,<175 and <100 to 932, <372 and<340, respectively, but these values were also significantly lower than the value against the prototype strain (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: The neutralizing GMTs elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' vaccination reached 3249, 1459, and 957 against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3, respectively.
source: Furthermore, remarkably enhanced neutralizing ID50 titers against Omicron were elicited by 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' vaccination, in which the neutralizing GMTs reached 3249, 1459, and 957 against BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3, respectively.
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay.

claim: The neutralizing GMTs boosted by mos-tri-RBD against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3 were 3.5-fold, >3.9-fold, and >2.8-fold higher than those boosted by homo-tri-RBD.
source: The neutralizing GMTs boosted by mos-tri-RBD against the three lineages of Omicron variant were 3.5-fold, >3.9-fold, and >2.8-fold higher than those boosted by homo-tri-RBD, and 8.5-fold, >8.3-fold, and >9.6-fold higher than by BBIBP-CorV, respectively (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: The neutralizing GMTs boosted by mos-tri-RBD against Omicron BA.1, BA.2, and BA.3 were 8.5-fold, >8.3-fold, and >9.6-fold higher than by BBIBP-CorV.
source: The neutralizing GMTs boosted by mos-tri-RBD against the three lineages of Omicron variant were 3.5-fold, >3.9-fold, and >2.8-fold higher than those boosted by homo-tri-RBD, and 8.5-fold, >8.3-fold, and >9.6-fold higher than by BBIBP-CorV, respectively (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is experimental data from pseudo-virus neutralization assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: For Beta, Gamma, Delta, Lambda, and Mu variants, the neutralizing antibody GMTs were increased 8.1-fold, 5.1-fold, 9.1-fold, 9.1-fold, and 5.6-fold, respectively, for 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' vaccination compared to 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccination.
source: Especially, for Beta, Gamma, Delta, Lambda, and Mu variants, the neutralizing antibody GMTs were increased 8.1-fold, 5.1-fold, 9.1-fold, 9.1-fold, and 5.6-fold, respectively, for 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' vaccination compared to 'BBIBP-CorV +BBIBP-CorV' vaccination, and 4.5-fold, 2.6-fold, 2.4-fold, 2.4-fold, and 3.2-fold, respectively, compared to 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD' vaccination (Figure 3B).

claim: For Beta, Gamma, Delta, Lambda, and Mu variants, the neutralizing antibody GMTs were increased 4.5-fold, 2.6-fold, 2.4-fold, 2.4-fold, and 3.2-fold, respectively, for 'BBIBP-CorV +mos-tri-RBD' vaccination compared to 'BBIBP-CorV +homo-tri-RBD' vaccination.
